Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner conflated “Xenoa” with the different film “Xeno (2025)” and anchored on the 2025 release date, implying they might be the same. This misinterpretation overlooked the actual film “Xenoa” (released August 22, 2007 in the Philippines) and would lead to the wrong comparison (suggesting Divorce Invitation 2012 was earlier) if not corrected later.
